snippet.title: Trailmarks Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
Trailmarks is a globe-spanning strategy adventure about travel, fact verification, and resource management. Travel by land, sea, and air, verify trivia, trade souvenirs, and manage time, money, and morale as you race to complete a full circumnavigation of the world.​

We're launching in Q1 2026!
